place_fields.vibe: Forest and wildlife setting in the Bhadra landscape
place_fields.summary: Muthodi is a forest tourism and safari area associated with Bhadra Tiger Reserve in Chikkamagaluru district.

planning_attributes.description: A forest tourism area associated with Bhadra Tiger Reserve and its wildlife safari experience.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Access is from the Chikkamagaluru side through the Muthodi forest area.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Forest and safari access is subject to applicable reserve and forest-department rules.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Follow forest and safari rules and remain with authorized safari arrangements in wildlife areas.

place_fields.summary: Mahatma Gandhi Park is a public park in Chikkamagaluru, also referred to as M G Park or Ratnagiri Bore in local travel references.

planning_attributes.description: A public recreational park in Chikkamagaluru used as a local leisure and visitor attraction.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Chikkamagaluru town and continue locally to Mahatma Gandhi Park.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Use normal care appropriate to a public urban park.
